$Comment: The Blight Warden's role template, the base of the three phase Variants (KweebecNightmare_Warden, _Phase2, _Phase3), which differ by MaxHealth, MaxSpeed and Burn only. The Warden fights through the Razorleaf instruction tree below (Target_Adjusted_Attack_Melee plus Intelligent_Chase), a hostile Kweebec spear fighter with huge sight, alerted and hearing ranges and no leash, so it hunts the party across the whole grove. Do not add a CombatActionEvaluator (UseCombatActionEvaluator or a _CombatConfig field) to this template: the Kweebec Razorleaf role builder does not read those keys, rejects the whole template on them, and every Variant that references it then fails to spawn. Burn is a PARAMETER rather than a top-level attribute: the Burn instruction block reads it through Enabled:{Compute:Burn}, so a Variant sets Burn true to wreathe itself in fire. The InteractionVars Melee_Damage entry is the heavy boss spear hit: it replaces NPC_Attack_Melee_Damage's calculator and knockback with Absolute Physical damage, so the Warden is dangerous whatever armor a survivor wears, and a strong launch that keeps the party honest. Which phase runs when is the Warden encounter script's business (Server/EncounterManager/KweebecNightmare_Warden_Encounter.json), which changes the role in place on the boss's health.

Appearance.Description: Model to be used (the large dark corrupted Warden reskin)

AlertedRange.Description: A range within which the player can be seen/sensed when the NPC is alerted to their presence

WatchRange.Description: The range at which the Warden will look at nearby (non-hostile) targets

DropList.Description: Drop Items (boss drops are granted via the round reward pipeline, not a vanilla drop list)

MaxSpeed.Description: Maximum walking speed (boss is deliberate; the corruption ramp + enrage layer on top of this)

AttackSequence.Description: The attack sequence to use in combat

AttackDistance.Description: The distance at which an NPC will execute attacks

MotionComponent.Description: The component to use for motion

CombatRelativeTurnSpeed.Description: Modifier that decides turn speed difference in combat

MaxHealth.Description: Max health for the Warden (per-phase Variant overrides this: 600 / 450 / 300)

Burn.Description: Whether the Warden is wreathed in fire (the Phase 3 enrage signal; consumed by the Burn instruction's Enabled compute, NOT a top-level role attribute)

IsMemory.Description: Defines if the NPC is a memory

MemoriesCategory.Description: Defines the category of the memory

MemoriesNameOverride.Description: Overrides the memory name if set

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display

Instructions.$Comment: Persistent Burn while the Phase-3 Variant flips Burn=true (mirrors Goblin_Duke_Phase_3_Fast). A no-op for Phases 1/2 (Burn=false disables the sensor).
Relentless boss chase: no soft leash, pursues the nearest survivor across the bounded arena (same intent as the Blight).

The Alerted-state handler. Every state a component in this template sets or exports (the Search component above exports Alerted) needs a handler of its own, or the role builder rejects the whole template with 'State setter ... without accompanying state/setter' and every Variant that references it fails to spawn, silently, with no error at the spawn call. The Warden has no investigate or converge stage: anything it senses escalates straight to Attack, which with its 512-block sight and hearing is what makes it relentless.
